title: T7 — Project baseline (retrospective, 2026-11-24)

# T7 — Project baseline (retrospective, 2026-11-24)

## Scope

The frozen scope baseline (kind `scope`, frozen) covers six deliverables, each with its four
WSJF inputs:

| # | Deliverable | Business value | Time criticality | Risk reduction | Job size |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Incidents are opened and triaged on the board from the operations queue | 9 | 8 | 7 | 2 |
| 2 | Runbooks and postmortems are governed documents linked to the incident | 8 | 7 | 6 | 2 |
| 3 | The four write verbs are callable and read back; an undeclared verb is refused | 9 | 8 | 8 | 3 |
| 4 | A destructive call without the tenant's configured approvals is refused | 9 | 7 | 9 | 2 |
| 5 | An approved mitigation sets mitigated_at with a read-back | 8 | 7 | 7 | 2 |
| 6 | Hosts are registered before use and a systemic finding opens exactly one kata | 7 | 6 | 6 | 2 |

The baseline gate froze this scope; the WBS rows were then accepted under the approved change
`Accept the T7 deliverables with their evidence`.

## Schedule

No schedule baseline row exists for T7. The project is delivered inside tranche 5 per
SPEC_V2 §12, and the tranche-5 review is its schedule record. Recorded as an explicit
absence.

## Cost

No cost baseline row exists for T7. Programme cost is the business case's quantified appraisal
(MSP); this project's cost is not separately baselined. Recorded as an explicit absence.

## Approval

The scope baseline was approved by `01a1e8a7-8b23-76a9-9114-aafb95f7a545`, distinct from its taker `01a1e607-17d9-77d3-98d3-a43a87c4633d`, and the
baseline gate is approved; the close gate named it.
